video.title: MVC, MVVM & Massive View Controller | Day 191
video.description:
Learn to explain app architecture patterns: MVC, MVVM & Massive View Controller, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
MVC - A pattern that splits an app into a model, a view and a controller that connects them.
MVVM - A pattern that puts the screen logic in a view model between the model and the view.
Massive View Controller - A name for a view controller that grew too big because it does every job.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS MVC, MVVM & Massive View Controller | Day 191
landscape.description:
Explain MVC, MVVM & Massive View Controller in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
MVC, MVVM, Massive View Controller 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

MVC - A pattern that splits an app into a model, a view and a controller that connects them.
한국어: MVC: 앱을 모델, 뷰, 컨트롤러로 나누는 패턴

MVVM - A pattern that puts the screen logic in a view model between the model and the view.
한국어: MVVM: 모델과 뷰 사이의 뷰 모델에 화면 로직을 두는 패턴

Massive View Controller - A name for a view controller that grew too big because it does every job.
한국어: Massive View Controller: 모든 일을 다 하느라 너무 커진 뷰 컨트롤러를 부르는 말

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about app architecture patterns, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

dialogue.title: Which pattern for Settings?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, our Settings screen is a mess. Which pattern should we use?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Most UIKit apps start with MVC: a model, a view and a controller.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So in MVC the controller connects the model to the view?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. But the controller often does too much. People call it a Massive View Controller.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What is inside a Massive View Controller?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Networking, parsing, saving and layout, all in one class.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds hard to test. Is there a better way?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try MVVM. The view model holds the screen logic, like `text` in our code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So MVVM keeps the view controller small?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The view only shows `text`, and the view model prepares it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But MVC is not wrong, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Correct. MVC works for small screens. Switch when you see a Massive View Controller.
Our old screens follow MVC, so the controller updates the view.
